groups.why: Same rendering problem: emit pyproject/__init__/package files from a template + user data.

merge.strategy: One generator; language/layout are flags, GitHub publishing is opt-in.
merge.cli_example: pyproj new mypkg --layout src --rust --github ; pyproj cargo-toml .
risks: pyproj touches the network/credentials; keep that path explicit and optional

evidence.interpretation: best measured pair 0.11: low by design, these use different libraries and identifier names for the same job; the grouping is semantic, not textual

scripts.purpose: Extract functions/classes/constants from files, archives or trees (AST/libcst/sqlite).
Extract docstrings and AST docs from modules into Markdown.

groups.why: Both parse the same AST/libcst trees and serialise a projection of them; only the output differs.

merge.strategy: Output target is a flag; docs become one of the writers.
merge.cli_example: pyextract --what docs --format md src/ ; pyextract --what defs --format sqlite src/
risks: docstring formatting is opinionated; keep the md template configurable

evidence.interpretation: best measured pair 0.06: low by design, these use different libraries and identifier names for the same job; the grouping is semantic, not textual

scripts.purpose: Save a page as one HTML file with CSS/JS/images inlined.

scripts.role: check and fix Markdown/HTML image links
scripts.purpose: Check and fix Markdown / HTML image links.

groups.why: Both resolve URLs against a base document and rewrite asset references — the shared piece is URL resolution and content-type guessing, not the CLI.

merge.strategy: Keep separate; extract the shared URL/mime helpers into one module.
risks: premature CLI merge would bloat both tools
merge.payoff: shared helper only (~60 lines deduplicated)

evidence.interpretation: best measured pair 0.14: low by design, these use different libraries and identifier names for the same job; the grouping is semantic, not textual

groups.title: Shared terminal-UI code
groups.task: Cross-cutting: raw-mode key handling, terminal sizing and ANSI rendering

scripts.purpose: Interactive fuzzy finder (fzf-like) over stdin lines with a preview pane.
Interactive disk-usage browser (TUI).
Interactive RGB colour chart for the terminal.
Terminal text viewer for PDFs (PyMuPDF extraction, scroll, goto page).
Terminal PDF viewer that renders pages as images (PPM).
Terminal PDF viewer that renders pages at a zoom level.
Display images, including SVG, in the terminal in true colour.
Display an image in the terminal with block characters.

groups.why: Eight scripts each hand-roll the same raw-mode key loop and terminal-size probe; the escape sequences are duplicated in at least four of them.

merge.strategy: Do NOT merge CLIs; extract keys/term/ansi into a common module.
risks: vendoring a module couples scripts that are currently standalone
merge.payoff: ~200 duplicated lines removed; one place to fix key decoding

evidence.interpretation: best measured pair 0.48: members duplicate key/TUI code, which is what the shared module should absorb (their CLIs stay separate)

merge.payoff: small; only worth it if a third linter wrapper appears
